summary: addEntry implemented with validation order amount, description (incl. RQ-FXL-0101 control chars), date, duplicate id; stored trimmed, unapproved.

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0001: 1,000,000.01 and 0 rejected with InvalidAmount

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0001: 200-char description after trimming accepted; 201 rejected

criteria.test: addEntry rejects duplicate id in any tenant

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0009: refund larger than original rejected

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0009: inactive session -> SessionExpired
